final_draft.answer: Yes. New EBS disks in our production AWS account (111122223333) are encrypted by default. A live check on 2026-11-17 confirmed this for the us-east-1 region.
final_draft.note: The answer reuses the approved wording, which runs until 2027-11-17. The approved answer says 'our AWS account' without calling it production. The production label comes from a separate approved answer about root-user MFA, which names the same account (111122223333) as production. The live check covered only us-east-1, which is the configured region. Other regions were not checked, so the answer should not be read as covering every region.
